# Map reference pixels into calibrated sheet coordinates.
def paper(u,v,z):
    return [.0135925-(v+.5)/1024*SIDE,.1135925-(u+.5)/1024*SIDE,z]

def make_base():
    pts=[]
    for j,v in enumerate(np.linspace(12,1011,45)):
        ends=[12,1011] if j%2==0 else [1011,12]
        for u in ends:pts.append(paper(u,v,.0125))
    return pts

def region_path(yy,xx,N=256,passes=2):
    from scipy import ndimage as ndi
    mask=np.zeros((N,N),bool);mask[yy,xx]=True
    padded=np.pad(mask,1);dist=ndi.distance_transform_edt(padded)[1:-1,1:-1]*SIDE*1000/N
    # Use finer pressure on boundary rows and firm pressure in wide interiors.
    interior=mask & (dist>=1.25)
    if not interior.any():interior=mask & (dist>=dist[mask].max()-.15)
    pts=[]
    step=1.6/(SIDE*1000/N)
    for pas in range(passes):
        rows=np.arange(yy.min()+pas*step/2,yy.max()+.01,step)
        if len(rows)==0:rows=[yy.mean()]
        direction=1
        for vr in rows:
            v=int(np.clip(round(vr),0,N-1));good=interior[v]
            ids=np.flatnonzero(good)
            if not len(ids):continue
            runs=np.split(ids,np.where(np.diff(ids)>1)[0]+1)
            if direction<0:runs=runs[::-1]
            for run in runs:
                coords=run if direction>0 else run[::-1]
                new=[]
                for u in coords:
                    d=float(dist[v,u]);dep=np.clip(.0009+.00013*max(0,d-1.25)**1.6,.0009,.0057)
                    if dist[mask].max()<1.8:dep=.0010
                    new.append(paper((u+.5)*1024/N-.5,(v+.5)*1024/N-.5,SURFACE-dep))
                if pts:
                    # A light contact joins subpaths, staying below the paper.
                    pts.append([pts[-1][0],pts[-1][1],.01965])
                    pts.append([new[0][0],new[0][1],.01965])
